lastCompletedStory.title: Switchover: route internal claude spawns through cam claude and add retry-pid helpers

nextStoryContext: US-007 is the wider cleanup story: remove claude-auto-retry from init.ts, resume.ts, index.ts HELP strings, embedded vendor, and tests. Key things to know: (1) `DetachedSpawnAdapter` now returns `number` (monitor PID) — US-007 does not need to change this. (2) `removeRetryPid` is already wired in `claude.ts`'s cleanup callback. (3) `resume.ts` currently uses `pgrep -f claude-auto-retry` (line 225) to detect liveness — US-007 should replace this with `readRetryPid()` + `isRetryPidAlive(pid)` from `src/util/retry-pid.ts`. (4) `init.ts` checks for `claude-auto-retry` on PATH (line 151) — US-007 should remove that check or replace it with an internal capability check.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only touched Node.js built-ins (process.kill, fs, os.homedir) and internal cam code. No external library API surface to validate.
